policy: One-environment four-model comparison (TF2.15.1, Keras2, native AdamW, 2 GPUs MirroredStrategy, synchronized BN, float32). FAT/Uniform/Preaggregation share network, loss, optimizer, batching and evaluation; FAT-vs-Uniform is the single-factor aggregation-rule ablation, FAT-vs-Preaggregation a method comparison, RF a conventional preaggregated baseline.
loss_boundary: original physical loss; finite zero subgradient at zero residual
normalization_fit_population: outer training fold, including the 4% monitoring-validation subset; no outer test data

uniform_geometry.height: per-half-hour positive finite zm=MH-d; same-timestep zm_smooth fallback only
uniform_geometry.snap: nearest full pixel edge; half ties outward

optimizer: native tf.optimizers.AdamW (Keras 2.15): variable -= lr*weight_decay*variable; beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, eps=1e-7

distribution.small_last_batch_rule: if last batch < replicas records, last 16+r records are split into two batches (9+8); no record dropped

smoke_policy: run.py --smoke --epochs N writes only to a results root whose name contains "smoke"; never certified/merged with production
